## Recognition Received in the Presence of Telangana IT & Industries Minister Sri Sridhar Babu

MGIT is proud to announce that our students have excelled at theDigital Technologies Hackathon 2025, conducted byEngineering Staff College of India (ESCI). The event brought together some of the brightest young innovators from across Telangana, showcasing the state’s growing strength inemerging technologies and digital skill development.
During the Skill Convocation ceremony held at ESCI, several MGIT students receivedcertificates of excellence and appreciation, recognizing their innovative solutions in areas such as:
- Artificial Intelligence
- Machine Learning
- Cybersecurity
- IoT & Smart Technologies
- Product Design & Digital Prototyping
- Software Development & Engineering
The Minister appreciated the hard work and talent demonstrated by Telangana’s youth and emphasized the state’s commitment to supporting advanced skill development. The event also highlighted Telangana’s progress toward becoming a leading hub fortechnology, innovation, and digital capabilitiesin India.

## 🎓MGIT’s Participation

MGIT continues to encourage and mentor students to take part in real-world innovation challenges that improve technical knowledge, creativity, and problem-solving abilities. Our faculty and mentors played a key role in guiding participants through multiple rounds of evaluation.

## 🏆A Moment of Pride

The recognition received by our students on such a prestigious platform reflects MGIT’s commitment to:
🌐 Quality engineering education💡 Innovation-driven learning🤝 Collaboration with national-level institutions🚀 Preparing students for future digital careers
MGIT congratulates all the students who participated and excelled in the event. Their success serves as an inspiration to the entire student community.
